title: geek-book configuration
description: The schema for book.config.json. Every key is optional: the engine has a default for each, so a book says only what it wants to change. An editor reads this through the config's `$schema` key, and `geek-book lint config` checks the file against it.

$schema.description: This schema, so an editor can validate the file.

title.description: The book's title, on the site and the cover (default: the package name).

author.description: The author's name, for the colophon.

version.description: What the version token resolves to in the prose (default: the package version).

placeholders.description: A book's own prose tokens, keyed by token name (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens).

language.description: The book's language, a BCP 47 tag (default: en). Sets the page's lang and, when the engine knows the language, the PDF's babel.

strings.description: Overrides for the fixed interface labels, English by default.

previous.description: The label of the previous-page link.

next.description: The label of the next-page link.

contents.description: The table of contents heading in the printed edition. Unset, a loaded language keeps babel's caption (English keeps the engine's name).

home.description: The Home link on a standalone rendered page.

toggle-navigation.description: The accessible name of the navigation toggle.

toggle-theme.description: The accessible name of the day/night theme toggle.

bookDir.description: Where the sources live, relative to the book root (default: book).

summary.description: The table of contents, relative to the book root (default: <bookDir>/SUMMARY.md). Its chapter links stay relative to the book directory.

chapters.description: The chapter prose directory, relative to the book root (default: <bookDir>/chapters). The chapter paths in SUMMARY.md stay relative to the book directory.

readme.description: The website's home page, relative to the book root (default: <bookDir>/README.md). With no file there the home page redirects to the first chapter.

cover.description: The cover image for the PDF (default: <bookDir>/cover.jpg; may be absent).

output.description: Where the two editions are written.

clean.description: Whether the website build empties its output directory first (default: true). Set false to write over what is there: files geek-book does not write stay, and pages removed from the book may linger.

docs.description: Root Markdown whose links the linter also checks (default: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md).

languages.description: The fence languages the linter accepts (default: the built-in set).

lint.description: The linter's line budgets, in columns.

proseWidth.description: The longest prose line the chapter check allows (default: 100).

diagramWidth.description: The widest text or ascii fence (default: 80).

markdown.description: How the Markdown source is read before either edition renders it.

smartTypography.description: Turn straight quotes into curly ones, and -- / --- into en and em dashes, in the prose (default: false). Code, link targets and raw HTML are left alone.

breaks.description: Turn a single newline inside a paragraph into a line break on the website (default: false). GFM hard breaks (two trailing spaces) still break either way. The printed edition always keeps a single newline soft.

diagrams.description: How the Mermaid diagrams are drawn, in both editions.

theme.description: The diagram theme (default: auto). auto derives the palette from tex.colors; a Mermaid theme name (default, dark, forest, neutral, ...) draws in that theme instead.

fontSize.description: The diagram type size, in pixels (default: 13).

code.description: A book's own code-fence languages: the label a block shows and how its comments are marked, for a language outside the built-in set. Each key is added to `languages`.

label.description: The label a code block shows (default: none).

comment.description: The comment syntax (default: the built-in choice, usually none).

images.description: Remote images the build fetches and carries, so neither edition sends the reader to the origin.

timeout.description: Seconds one remote-image fetch may take before it fails (default: 30).

types.description: Accepted content types, each mapped to the file extension it is saved as. Empty keeps the engine's built-in map; a type left out is refused.

fonts.description: The typefaces both editions are set in (default: Literata and JetBrains Mono).

text.description: The body text, the headings and the diagrams.

bold.description: The text font's bold face, as a fontspec declaration (Family:options).

code.description: The family code blocks are set in.

web.description: The webfont stylesheet the website loads; empty loads none.

tex.description: The printed edition's page, palette and type scale.

geometry.description: The paper and its margins, in millimetres.

colors.description: The printed edition's palette, each value #rrggbb.

tocDepth.description: Table of contents depth (0 for chapters only, default: 0).

titlePage.description: Print a typographic title page — the title, the tagline and the author — before the table of contents (default: false).

copyright.description: A copyright line for the front matter's imprint page (default: none).

isbn.description: An ISBN for the front matter's imprint page (default: none).

preamble.description: A file of extra LaTeX, relative to the book root, appended after the built-in preamble.

web.description: What the website says about itself and adds to the built-in look. The standalone page the md command renders keeps its own layout.

css.description: A file of CSS, relative to the book root, appended after the built-in stylesheet.

head.description: A file of HTML, relative to the book root, injected into every page's <head> (analytics, meta).

baseUrl.description: The site's base URL: an absolute URL (https://example.com/book/) that also feeds the canonical and social tags, or a root-relative path (/book/) that only moves the site's root links. Empty means /.

description.description: The one-line description search engines and social cards show (default: the tagline).

favicon.description: The site's favicon, relative to the book root, copied into the output.

prettyUrls.description: Write a page as <name>/index.html instead of <name>.html, so its URL carries no extension (default: false). The home page is the root's index.html either way; assets are plain files in both schemes.

links.description: Labelled links the site's footer carries, in order. In an href, {path} becomes the page's source path from the book root and {url} its absolute URL.

port.description: The port geek-book serve listens on when its argument names none (default: 4000).
